classification: exploratory feasibility pilot, not a significance study
hypotheses: Independent PPO can improve repeated legal-maximum completion
GUM and PPO differ under matched information/reward/interaction contracts
Only a repeatably successful development candidate may be examined for Room A transfer
hard_room_a: frozen, no training/evaluation in this pilot; conditional separately preregistered examination
timeout_semantics: declared finite-horizon episode ends, zero bootstrap for both methods; no administrative cutoff
observations: each member's 96x160 RGB raster; own previous anonymous action and scalar reward; episode start; own recurrent history
inactive_reward_accounting: Every elapsed inactive joint tick is counted including zero-reward ticks. Subsequent public team reward at delay k enters the last executed action's reward with gamma^k. No fictitious actions; escape is not a joint boundary. Both methods use this adapter. GUM's historical undiscounted-tail bookkeeping is therefore explicitly corrected for this contract, while its loss and shared value gradient remain original.
initialization: four independent random policies and fresh optimizers per team; no inherited trained checkpoints

implementations.ppo: gum/school/independent_ppo.py: standard recurrent clipped PPO, GAE, orthogonal initialization, full episode minibatches, fresh recurrent reconstruction each pass
implementations.gum: gum/school/recurrent_meta.py original actor-critic plus ElapsedRewardGUMLearner accounting adapter

reference_provenance: audited development condition novelty-off-action-mixer-off. Retains its 20% uniform training mixture. Common frozen-evaluation temperature is 1 instead of historical 0.25. PPO samples its own categorical policy with no uniform mixture.
comparison_scope: complete methods: representation, GRU design, action memories, discount, GAE, sampling, batching and optimizer differ; no claim that PPO objective alone causes any difference
evaluation_schedule: Same fixed 32 untouched development instances per team at every checkpoint and both methods; revealed only by protocol runner, no tuning or best-checkpoint selection. Previously used credit/gradient seeds excluded.
primary_outcome: legal maximum three-member escape completion rate at fixed final checkpoint 256
secondary_outcomes: plate occupancy and longest continuous member dwell
peak process RSS and CUDA allocation
replication_justification: Four independently trained teams per method support a bounded feasibility assessment and expose seed dependence. With only four teams uncertainty is coarse; not powered for significance or population reliability. At least 4/32 completions and a 4/32 gain in at least three teams avoids classifying an isolated escape as success.
analysis: Report every team and checkpoint. Paired method final rates and within-team before/after gains; 10000 team-level bootstrap samples and exploratory t intervals. Episodes and four members are not independent replication units. Degenerate zero bootstrap intervals cannot bound unseen population success or establish impossibility.

tuning.stopping: fixed budget regardless of observed outcomes; abort on invalid implementation, archive, recovery, or frozen-state check

compute: CPU, one PyTorch thread, deterministic operations; joint interaction ceilings matched, actual shorter completed episodes reported; compute not equalized. PPO multiple epochs explicitly counted. Report observation/render/archive/viewer overhead within wall time and process memory; not exclusive model memory.
validation_gate: all arithmetic/sequence/action/mode/old-probability/recovery/frozen-state unit checks pass; all three separate pixel relationship learners reach >=0.8 accuracy and >=0.5 improvement
artifact_rules: retain every complete transition, timeout, failure, successful episode, all four optimizer/RNG states and pending PPO rollouts; ledger/checkpoint positions agree or reload rejects; read-only live view and full episode playback, method/phase/team/seed/tick/resources labels; showcase first training and final evaluation episode by ordinal, no success selection

decision_rules.ppo_only_success: tested GUM configuration bottleneck evidence; freeze PPO and preregister new Room A exam
decision_rules.both_success: compare reliability, retention on fixed development instances, resources; preregister Room A transfer for fixed final candidates
decision_rules.gum_only_success: tested PPO pilot configuration fails; freeze GUM only for preregistered transfer
decision_rules.neither_success: report no reliable cooperation under this budget; no Room A exam, no architectural patch; a larger-budget or alternative-method study needs a new hypothesis/protocol
decision_rules.implementation_failure: stop and label implementation failure, not method failure
